title: Na Ro Aun Di Amri Tur Ja Aj Shaam Nu Baaj Ridda Dai
body:
Na Tak Enj Nehar Dai Paasai (x2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Tainoo Shaamiyan Dai Nai Pathraan Dai Nazraanai
Tu Bharjayiyaan Sang Rulna Dais Beghanai
Zainab Tu Parda Daar Ai Kinj Ker Dai Wich Bazaraan Vai’rn Bhira Dai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Mun Paak Fiza Dai Ohlai Sain Luka Lai
Lah Sir Tun Maa Da Burkha Raseeyan Paa Lai
Rakhi Hosla Zahra Jayee Tainiu Turna Payna’ay Paidal Naal Sipha Dai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Barbaad Gharaan Di Kardi Pehrai Daari
Akbar Da Na Murna Ban’naya Beemari
Payi Kalaiya Bain Bain Rovai
Hai Aun Kai Nayee Koi Sunda Dukh Sughra Dai.
<<DIVIDER>>
Putran Nal Rehnda Maa Tai Piyo Da Naa Ai, Aj Koi Kendha Nahi Aj Zainab Sadee Maa Ai (x2)
Vich Karbobala Dai Lut Layee
Kalma Gohwaan Nai Zainab Dee Aulaad Ai.
